name: Neural Latent Regularization
definition: A regularization technique using a small neural network $\Phi_f$ to reconstruct grid features from canonical coordinates and timestamps, preventing overfitting of the radiance field without affecting inference speed.
summary: Neural Latent Regularization prevents radiance field overfitting by using a small auxiliary network to reconstruct grid features from canonical coordinates and timestamps, distinguishing itself by regularizing the grid representation rather than the transfer function or output colors.
